originalTitle: Silver Storm Parks & Resorts Limited successfully concludes IPO
simplifiedContent: Silver Storm Parks & Resorts Limited, a company that runs entertainment parks, has successfully raised ₹82.43 crore from its initial public offering (IPO). This means that the company has sold its shares to the public for the first time and received a large amount of money in return. Many big investors, as well as regular people, showed interest in buying the company's shares. The company plans to use this money to expand its attractions, including a new cable car and forest village, and also build new snow parks in different locations. This is important because it shows that investors are interested in the company's growth plans and are willing to put their money into it.

originalTitle: GHCL Q1 profit rises 32% to Rs 191 cr on lower costs, warns of margin pressure ahead
simplifiedContent: GHCL, a company, made a profit of Rs 191.18 crore in the first quarter, which is 32% more than what they made last year. This increase in profit happened because their expenses were lower than before. Even though the company's total income went down by 3.06%, their lower expenses helped them make more money. The company is expecting some challenges ahead that might affect their profit margins, but they are hopeful about their long-term prospects. They also have new projects that are expected to start making money soon, in the second quarter of this financial year.

originalTitle: CDSL Q1 Results: Net profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 118 crore, revenue up 13%
simplifiedContent: CDSL, a company that helps store and manage financial securities in India, just released its quarterly results. The company's profit increased by 15% compared to the same time last year, reaching Rs 118 crore. Its revenue, which is the money it earns from its main activities, also went up by 13% to Rs 293 crore. This means the company is making more money than it was a year ago, which is a good sign. This increase in profit and revenue is important because it shows that CDSL is performing well financially.

originalTitle: Buy or sell: Ganesh Dongre of Anand Rathi recommends 3 stocks to buy on Monday - 3 August 2026
simplifiedContent: There's tension in the Middle East that's affecting the Indian stock market. Despite this, a market expert named Ganesh Dongre from a company called Anand Rathi is suggesting that investors buy certain stocks on Monday. He has chosen three specific stocks that he thinks are good to buy. This is important because if you're invested in the stock market, you might want to consider his recommendations to make informed decisions about your investments. By following his advice, you may be able to make some money or avoid losing some, depending on how the stocks perform.

originalTitle: RBI MPC meeting to Q1 results FY27, US-Iran war: Top five triggers that may dictate the Indian stock market this week
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a good day, with two important indexes, the Nifty and Sensex, going up by 2.59% and 2.68% respectively. This week, there are some new factors that could affect how the stock market performs. One of these factors is a meeting of the RBI's Monetary Policy Committee, and another is the release of companies' results for the first quarter of the financial year. There are also some international events, like the situation between the US and Iran, that could impact the market. These factors could influence how the stock market does this week, so investors are paying attention to them.

originalTitle: Crushed by Kospi Rout, Angry Koreans Rip Lee and Vow Not to Buy
simplifiedContent: There's been a big drop in the South Korean stock market, called the Kospi, and it's affecting individual investors in the country. These investors, who are used to taking risks, are now really upset and feeling shaken by the sudden change. They're reacting strongly to the losses they've experienced, and some are even saying they won't invest anymore. This is notable because South Korean individual investors are known for being willing to take on risk, but this recent drop has pushed them to their limits. The situation shows that even experienced investors can be rattled by big market changes.
